## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9ebb01000ceb9e0160dbb6fab6faec99d78a0d94`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/hotcrm.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md

Inputs read: card #25558 body and both comments (ruling 6378083450, the seat's claim 6378144834); PR #25593 body, file list and `git diff origin/main...origin/claude/project-thread-r6oa8t` (4 files, +24/−3, one commit, merge-base = `origin/main` e0734559 which already carries #25552 and #25585); the head's check-runs (47), read 2026-10-24T03:10Z, 2026-10-24T03:13Z and 2026-10-24T03:18Z. Adversarial read: the dispatch order and the seat's own conclusions were not inputs.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Ruling D carried faithfully, item by item.** Item 1 (app project summons a 总监席 for the first-touch review of its cards' 业务理由, 「三出口同分诊」, 「总监席不认领、不落地」): director.md +1 「应用仓召唤本席复核卡的业务理由首触,三出口同分诊;没把握 ⇒ 报该应用的总监(人)裁。」 and triage.md +1 「应用仓业务理由由该项目召唤的总监席复核;第三方应用的总监是其自身维护者。」 — the latter is the ruling's workload sentence byte-for-byte, placed after 「应用仓无分诊席」 as the ruling orders. 不认领/不落地 is already director.md line 20 「永不认领 backlog、永不写码」 and SKILL.md row 56; the new line adds nothing that contradicts it. Item 2 (third-party app's 总监 = its own maintainer; roles only, no logins): carried in triage.md; the three edited lines name only roles (应用仓、总监席、维护者、立卡人) — grep for logins over the diff is empty. Item 3 (platform-change cards still file to objectstack triage): existing behaviour, hotcrm.md 「建设 hotcrm 时发现的平台能力缺口,立普通平台卡到 objectstack 或 objectui」 / 「那是 file-at-destination、非缝卡、待分诊」 — no text owed, none added. Item 4 (brief option A demoted to fallback): A was never written into director.md 职责四 (the daily digest line names no app-repo sampling), so there is nothing to demote; no text owed, none added. Nothing beyond the ruling's workload was added — the diff is exactly the three files the ruling names plus the gate rows those lines force.
2. **The three exits resolve.** 「三出口同分诊」 in director.md resolves to filing-gate.md lines 26–28 (清楚且合北极星方向 ⇒ 入队 / 缺失或站不住 ⇒ `Triage: returned` / 产品取舍或方向不明 ⇒ `needs-user-decision`) and triage-duties.md line 35 「首触先按业务理由三出口分流,再定级路由」. The director line's own clause 「没把握 ⇒ 报该应用的总监(人)裁」 re-points the third exit's human to the app's own 总监, which is the ruling's 「产品取舍或没把握 ⇒ 报该应用自己的总监(人)裁」; the 产品取舍 half rides on the imported third exit, whose card lands in the app repo's own inbox (cross-repo-coordination.md 「决策卡入本仓收件箱,不落 objectstack」) and is presented by the summoned director seat (SKILL.md 276 「总监席是唯一呈裁席」). Coherent; no second place defines the exits.
3. **Single-lane seat's duty stays coherent.** cross-repo-coordination.md 机械三务 now reads 「自做首触(含 `finding`;业务理由归召唤的总监席)」: the `repo:*` seat keeps sweep, `type`, `finding` and grading (hotcrm.md line 8 「机械三务(含首触定级)…自理」 still true), and the rationale judgement and its exit comment move to the director seat, whose line says the exits are triage's — so the `Triage: returned` / `needs-user-decision` writes are the director seat's, in triage's shape. One thing the text leaves to the reader: in an app repo the two halves of 「首触先按业务理由三出口分流,再定级路由」 now sit in two seats, and no line says the `repo:*` seat waits for the director's exit before grading. The ruling named no ordering and its workload was three one-liners, so this is an observation for the Skills seat's notes, not a defect of this PR.
4. **Ratchet rows are each exactly the measured delta, cited to the ruling id.** director.md 87 → 88 against a measured 87 → 88 on `origin/main`…head; triage.md 7 → 8 against 7 → 8; cross-repo-coordination.md 51 → 51 (in-place rewrite, no row moved). Both comments quote the ruling comment id 6378083450 and the maintainer's word 「#25558 记为 D」 verbatim, as the ratchet header's ordinary-raise exit requires (ruling id + measured delta in the PR body, row moved by at most that delta — the body states both). No other `CEILINGS` row moved.
5. **The `ruledRaises` record on the director.md move is well-formed and the arithmetic closes.** Record = `{ruling: '…「#25558 记为 D」…', date: '2026-10-24', delta: 1}`: the ruling string matches `VERBATIM_QUOTATION` (「…」 present), the date matches `RULED_RAISE_DATE`, delta is a positive integer; the self-test's live-map assertion (every record quotes, dates and names a positive count) holds for it. Read against `crossFileMoveVerdict`: gross = 88 − 70 = 18, ruled = 1, move raise = 17, source decrease = 120 − 103 (triage-duties.md ceiling at head, unchanged by this PR) = 17 → 17 ≤ 17 passes; `crossFileMoveTotalVerdict` restores the destination at `was` + 1 = 71, so net = (88 − 71) + (103 − 120) = 0, unchanged. `was` was correctly left at 70, not carried forward — the header's stated trap avoided. The PR body's reading 「+17 less 1 ruled line against −17」 matches this derivation.
6. **Line-length and provenance rules.** Edited .md lines measure 112, 119 and 108 bytes (all ≤ 120). The three skill lines carry no issue number, date or login (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` corpus clean by inspection); the ratchet script's `(#25558)` citations follow that file's own row convention and are outside the id-lint corpus. The commit's trailer pair is model-free (`Claude-Session:` + `Co-Authored-By: Claude`); no model identifier in title, body or comments.
7. **Base and claim.** Branch starts at `origin/main` e0734559 (the #25552 merge), so the 「应用仓无分诊席」 anchor line exists in the base and the 「在 PR #25552 之后落」 ordering is satisfied; #25585 is also in the base. The card's newest `Claim:` names this branch and session; `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` is green.

### ② Semver level

skip-changeset — correct. The diff touches `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only; no released package moves. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` are declared on the PR body and match the diff (no protocol surface touched).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed surface: `.claude/**` (register row `claude-tree`, Tier S). `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is not on the register (adr, claude-tree, skills-catalog, agents-md, claude-md, north-star, workflows); it is read here as the gate paired with the rule. Tier S landing = this record (PASS) + every check green + the owning seat through the queue. PR is draft, `mergeable_state: blocked`; nothing armed.
- **Landing condition, not a verdict item:** the two ordinary ceiling raises (director.md 87 → 88, triage.md 7 → 8) are the maintainer's to authorise. The ruling of record 6378083450 orders the text that forces them, and the PR cites it per the ratchet header's exit, but the seat has also put the raises to the maintainer on a decision card in the Skills seat thread; the seat lands only after that answer. Recorded here as a condition the seat confirms before landing.
- Check-runs on the head (48, final read 2026-10-24T03:17Z, nothing left `in_progress`): every non-skipped run concluded `success` — the required contexts `Lint & Repo Gates` (whose `Lint · repo & tooling gates` leg runs `check:pm-skill-ratchet`), `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (1–6 of 6) and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` included, plus Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Lint · PM dispatch-gates and the three card/claim guards. `Build Core` and the full-battery jobs (Console Pin Gate, Temporal Conformance, Build Docs, Dogfood shards) are `skipped` by the path filter on a docs-only diff. Earlier reads 2026-10-24T03:10Z and 2026-10-24T03:13Z had six runs still in progress; none of them went red.
- Not in scope and untouched: any Tier H path, the human-ruling floor in triage-duties.md, `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. No GitHub writes by this review; the seat posts this record.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-r6oa8t`
Reviewed-by: `session_01REMuzhz6MWRjg8uohedMnM`

**VERDICT: PASS**
